# slo-burn-rate

> SLO error budget math and Google SRE multi-window, multi-burn-rate alert evaluation as a pure library and a CLI over timestamped good and bad counts. Python package `trysac-slo-burn-rate`, import name `slo_burn_rate`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and input limits
